snippet.title: Mr Records - Level Editor Reveal | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

George is an old dreamer who finally opens his dream record store with his dog Buzz, and at night every vinyl turns into a playable rhythm journey. Now you can build your own levels by uploading your MP3s!
